scope: Read-only checks and descriptive analysis of pinned outputs; no fitted correction or new circuit measurement.
claim_boundary: The design follows inspection of existing test results. These are exploratory diagnostics, not preregistered confirmatory hypotheses or causal feature importance.

locations: Section III-A, shot-count and fixed-overhead discussion
scholten.paper_formula: T_hat = M * S * D_eff / C; D_eff = mean_depth(kernel) / mean_depth(QV_v) * v; v = ceil(sqrt(2 * template_repetitions * n))
scholten.difference: Generic wire depth is not the paper's QV-normalized effective depth. The local single-circuit route sets M=1 and retains mixed, explicitly identified nominal CLOPS definitions.
scholten.prohibited_interpretation: Poor generic-depth adaptation scores do not establish that the original QV-normalized model fails on its original workload.

hyb_hanas.stable_formula: log(T_eff) = log(T_gate) + T_gate/T2 - sum_b N_b * log1p(-mean_error_b)
hyb_hanas.difference: Minimum-active-T2, bucket error aggregation and composite nominal calibration are local disclosed choices. The effective sampling penalty is not an observed physical retry or provider service clock.
checks: A positive count with bucket error 1 gives zero survival, not a numerical overflow
Finite log cost above log(float64.max) is exponentiation overflow, not missing calibration
Routing cost is not added twice: T_logical + T_routing equals T_gate in the selected component
No parameter-shift or total-training multiplier is inserted into the one-circuit target
hyb_hanas.prohibited_interpretation: A calibration repair does not prove that exponentially penalized effective cost predicts observed execution time.

qcre.paper_mechanism: Per-wire weighted critical path; weights can be gate-duration ratios, and durations produce an ASAP critical-path timing estimate.
qcre.difference: Agreement with Qiskit scheduling is an implementation/timing check, not proof of observed service-time accuracy. A dimensionless weighted rank has no MAE in seconds.
checks: SI seconds versus dt conversion is explicit
Virtual RZ may have zero duration; zero is not missing
Directive synchronization follows the declared schedule contract
Measurement/reset/delay inclusion follows the specific method, not a blanket cross-method rule

scholten.interpretation: Arithmetic follows the frozen generic-depth formula. The extreme mismatch is not fixed by relabelling wire depth as QV layers or adjusting throughput after inspecting errors.

hyb.interpretation: Saved composite calibration resolves nominal zero-survival coverage but does not resolve the effective-cost versus execution-clock mismatch.

diagnostic_slices.numeric_bin_convention: (previous boundary, boundary], final null means +infinity; also retain exact shots values
diagnostic_slices.tail_rows: Top 20 by absolute error per method; mark this label-selected slice retrospective, not a training exclusion rule
diagnostic_slices.duplicate_support: Count train/test exact feature or representation signatures per frozen outer fold. Different contracts require their own signatures, including Ma-Li node calibration. Do not claim workflow-grouped splits are unseen-structure holdouts.
diagnostic_slices.rare_class_definition: At most five distinct frozen leakage groups, not at most five rows; annotate deterministic structural rarity separately from label-selected error rarity.

comparison.rows: Join by canonical observation ID, verify target/source/outer-fold equality and hash sorted successful intersection IDs before comparing
comparison.r2_edge_policy: null with explicit reason when fewer than two observations or zero target variance; do not coerce to a perfect or zero score
comparison.negative_and_log_policy: Score finite negative raw predictions unchanged in seconds metrics and report negative-output rate. Compute log1p-MAE only on target>=0 and prediction>=0 with explicit log_metric_n and invalid-domain count; never silently clip to produce log metrics.
comparison.macro_policy: Report an equal-source macro only if every canonical source has at least one successful scored row; otherwise null and show missing sources
comparison.graph_mlp: Same raw 51-global matrix, row eligibility, target transform, seeds, batches and schedule. Different errors can test the incremental graph branch only under that matched contract.
comparison.graph_structure_claim_boundary: The added graph branch also receives node types, wire positions, T1/T2 and node indices. This comparison does not isolate connectivity or edge direction alone. Such a claim requires separately controlled node-only/calibration-matched ablations, not an inference from the graph-versus-global-MLP score.
comparison.existing_seven_feature_scores: Descriptive only relative to the new full-source model, since graph widths, encoders and target transforms differ.

no_error_driven_repair: No upper clipping or global factor chosen from outer-test errors
No feature/snapshot selection by held-out score
No new QV reference measurement or circuit compilation in this diagnostic queue
No imputed prediction for failed/unavailable rows
No claim of causal feature importance from correlation
